## Location maps

The maps below dsiplay the locations of hydra collected thought the world. For clarity the world amp ahs been divided into region. Please select the region you want to display. There is little we can do aboout the map projection which distorts the true areas of the world exagerating lands at higher latitudes. 

PLease lect the map from North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. 

```{r}
#| echo: false
# 1. Load libraries and copy data
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)

my_data <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dem04747/data/main/hydra_tiny.csv")
```



```{r}
#| echo: false
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

my_data2 <- my_data %>%
  mutate(
    lat2 = parse_number(as.character(lat2)),
    long2 = parse_number(as.character(long2))
  )

```


```{r}
#| echo: false
# Convert coordinates to sf object using your actual column names (longitude first, then latitude)
hydra_sf <- my_data2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat2), !is.na(long2)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long2", "lat2"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = "osm", zoom = 1) + 
  geom_sf(data = hydra_sf, aes(color = species), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "canadensis"   = "red",
    "circumcincta" = "darkorange",
    "hymanae"      = "pink",
    "lirosoma"     = "purple",
    "oligactis"    = "blue",
    "utahensis"    = "gold",
    "viridissima"  = "forestgreen",
    "vulgaris"     = "sienna"
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hydra Locations")
```



```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
hydra_sf <- my_data %>%
  mutate(
    lat2 = parse_number(as.character(lat2)),
    long2 = parse_number(as.character(long2))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat2), !is.na(long2), lat2 != 0, long2 != 0) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long2", "lat2"), crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
library(dplyr)

# Check rows where lat2 became NA after coercion
bad_rows <- my_data %>%
  mutate(lat2_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lat2))) %>%
  filter(is.na(lat2_num) & !is.na(lat2))

# View those rows to see what text is hiding in the column
print(bad_rows)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
ggplot(data = hydra_sf) +
  geom_sf(color = "red", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hydra Locations")
```
